Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch verification playbook + QBR snapshot

Team —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. I pulled together a compact playbook (attached) that synthesizes the cross-functional verification checklist we agreed on for the Stratus pilot launch and the short QBR snapshot we should run next week. High level:

- GTM: confirm demo scripts, one live demo path, and primary/secondary success metrics.
- Enablement: final slide deck + two hands-on lab exercises for CSMs.
- Pricing: attach fallback pricing for a 3-month pilot and renewal triggers.
- Docs: single-source quickstart + troubleshooting appendix.
- Support: on-call escalation matrix + runbook for token/latency incidents.

Action items I need before Monday:
1) Marissa — confirm enablement deck final (slide 32+33 need usage examples).
2) Karthik — pricing fallback + legal redline summary to share with AcmeCorp.
3) Laura — confirm support on-call rotations during pilot week (Mar 29–Apr 2).
4) Ben — QA signoff on demo scripts and two recorded demos attached.

I attached launch_playbook_v1.pdf and the enablement draft. Please reply with quick thumbs-up or outstanding blockers. I will compile a 1-page QBR snapshot for the exec review with the updated ask status.

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: launch_playbook_v1.pdf (34p, checklist), enablement_slide_deck.pptx (draft)

- ETA: final deck by Wed 5pm PT.

One question on timing: do we want enablement rehearsals with the pilot CSMs on Thu (Mar 25) or Fri (Mar 26)? I lean Thu to give a day buffer for edits.

Folks —

Attached is a short pricing fallback note (one page) and a summary of legal redlines we expect from AcmeCorp procurement. Key callouts:
- Pilot discount: 20% off list for initial 3 months; auto-renews at standard committed pricing unless opt-out in renewal window.
- SLA: Pilot SLA will be commercial-best-effort; any SLA exceptions need leadership approval.
- Data retention: log retention settings documented in the playbook, default 30 days for pilot telemetry.

I copied AcmeCorp procurement so they see the fallback; Naomi, if you want me to take point on the renewal trigger language I can draft the clause with legal and loop you in.

- Pricing: Karthik to draft the renewal-trigger clause by EOD Wed; legal to follow.

I'll circulate the final QBR snapshot + exec note on Thu morning (Mar 24) and schedule a 20-minute alignment call for Thu 11am PT for any last-minute clarifications.

Thanks all — this is on track.
